title: My child has rigid behaviour. Can Occupational Therapy help?
metaTitle: Overcoming Rigid Behaviour with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's Occupational Therapy services can help your child move past rigid behaviours, introduce flexibility and develop better coping mechanisms to manage change.
html: Absolutely, we can make a difference. If your child exhibits rigid behaviours, Occupational Therapy services at Pinnacle Blooms Network can be highly beneficial. We understand that each child is unique with distinct needs. Rigid behaviours, often seen in children with autism, can limit them from exploring new experiences. Our therapists aim to gently interrupt these behaviours, introducing flexibility through subtle routine modifications and exposure to new activities. Most importantly, the therapists ensure to equip your child with compatible coping skills to manage better with changes.
